capabilities: Replace the heading fold icon with a single rotating chevron
Extend the fold click target across the whole heading row
Place a chevron widget at the end of headings in Live Preview and Source
Configure icon style, visibility and affected heading levels
Drive Obsidian's own fold state so Outline and Fold all stay in sync
disambiguation: Not a collapsible content-block or callout plugin; it only changes the visual control for Obsidian's existing heading fold.
extras: Only ATX headings (#–######) are affected; Setext headings keep Obsidian's default behaviour. Requires Obsidian 1.5.0 or later. Beta installs go through BRAT.
intentEvidence: Obsidian's built-in heading fold puts a chevron on the left that disappears when the section is expanded
motivation: The author wanted the standard accordion pattern used across the web instead of Obsidian's two separate fold controls.
problem: Obsidian's built-in heading fold shows two different affordances in two places: a chevron that disappears when a section is expanded and a separate … when it is collapsed.
summary: Restyles Obsidian's heading fold control as a web-style accordion with one rotating chevron and a full-row click target.
